tools.name: calc_rent_schedule
tools.description: Build a base-rent schedule from commencement date, term, area, starting $/SF/yr, escalations (percent or fixed $/SF), and abated months. Returns rent steps, totals, expiration date, and a calculation trace. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.rent_schedule@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

term_months.description: Lease term in months, e.g. 120 for ten years.

starting_rent_psf_annual.description: Year-one base rent in dollars per SF per year.

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

oneOf.description: Flat rent for the whole term.

rate.description: Bump as a decimal, e.g. 0.03 for 3%. Bumps compound.

amount.description: Dollars per SF per year added at each bump, e.g. 0.50.

oneOf.description: Fixed $/SF bumps: rate_k = starting_rate + amount × k.

abated_months.description: Fully abated months, 1-based (e.g. [1,2,3] for three months free up front).

round_rate_to_cents.description: Round each step's $/SF/yr to cents, as many lease rent tables do.

include_monthly.description: Include a month-by-month table (can be long).

tools.name: calc_net_effective_rent
tools.description: Compute effective rent, straight-line net effective rent, and discounted net effective rent ($/SF/yr) after free rent, TI allowance, leasing commissions, and other landlord concessions. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.net_effective_rent@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

term_months.description: Lease term in months, e.g. 120 for ten years.

starting_rent_psf_annual.description: Year-one base rent in dollars per SF per year.

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

oneOf.description: Flat rent for the whole term.

rate.description: Bump as a decimal, e.g. 0.03 for 3%. Bumps compound.

amount.description: Dollars per SF per year added at each bump, e.g. 0.50.

oneOf.description: Fixed $/SF bumps: rate_k = starting_rate + amount × k.

abated_months.description: Fully abated months, 1-based (e.g. [1,2,3] for three months free up front).

round_rate_to_cents.description: Round each step's $/SF/yr to cents, as many lease rent tables do.

include_monthly.description: Include a month-by-month table (can be long).

schedule.description: The lease's base-rent terms (same input as calc_rent_schedule).

leasing_commissions.description: Total leasing commissions paid by landlord, USD.

other_concessions.description: Any other landlord concessions paid at commencement (moving allowance, buyout), USD.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate; 0 gives the undiscounted (straight-line) NER.

tools.name: calc_compare_proposals
tools.description: Rank 2–20 lease proposals with different terms, sizes, free rent, TI, concessions, and expense structures on one discounted $/SF/yr basis: effective occupancy cost (tenant perspective) or discounted net effective rent (landlord perspective). Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.compare_proposals@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate applied to every proposal (monthly rate = annual ÷ 12).

name.description: Unique label for the proposal, e.g. building name.

commencement_date.description: Rent commencement date, YYYY-MM-DD. Month n starts on this day-of-month (clamped to month end).

term_months.description: Lease term in months, e.g. 120 for ten years.

starting_rent_psf_annual.description: Year-one base rent in dollars per SF per year.

escalation.description: How base rent escalates. Omit for flat rent.

oneOf.description: Flat rent for the whole term.

rate.description: Bump as a decimal, e.g. 0.03 for 3%. Bumps compound.

amount.description: Dollars per SF per year added at each bump, e.g. 0.50.

oneOf.description: Fixed $/SF bumps: rate_k = starting_rate + amount × k.

abated_months.description: Fully abated months, 1-based (e.g. [1,2,3] for three months free up front).

round_rate_to_cents.description: Round each step's $/SF/yr to cents, as many lease rent tables do.

include_monthly.description: Include a month-by-month table (can be long).

schedule.description: Base-rent terms of this proposal (same input as calc_rent_schedule).

other_concessions.description: Other cash concessions to the tenant at commencement (moving allowance, buyout), USD.

leasing_commissions.description: Leasing commissions paid by landlord, USD (landlord perspective only).

additional_costs_psf_annual.description: Costs the tenant pays on top of base rent, $/SF/yr, e.g. estimated operating expenses and taxes on a NNN proposal. Use 0 for full-service gross.

tenant_upfront_costs.description: Tenant's own costs at commencement not covered by allowances (TI overage, moving), USD.

tools.name: calc_percentage_rent
tools.description: Percentage (overage) rent for a lease year: net sales after exclusions over a natural or fixed breakpoint, prorated for partial years, less amounts already paid. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.percentage_rent@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

gross_sales.description: Gross sales reported for the lease year (or partial year).

sales_exclusions.description: Sales excluded by the lease (returns, sales tax, gift cards, employee sales, …).

base_rent_annual.description: Annual base rent; used for the natural breakpoint.

breakpoint.description: Breakpoint above which percentage rent applies. Default: natural.

oneOf.description: Natural breakpoint = annual base rent ÷ rate.

amount.description: Annual sales breakpoint stated in the lease, USD.

oneOf.description: Artificial (fixed) breakpoint stated in the lease.

period_fraction.description: Fraction of a full lease year covered (e.g. 0.5 for a six-month partial year). Prorates the breakpoint.

percentage_rent_paid.description: Percentage rent already paid during the period.

tools.name: calc_cam_reconciliation
tools.description: Reconcile a tenant's annual CAM charge: exclusions, occupancy gross-up of variable expenses, pro rata share, controllable-expense caps (compounding_from_base, simple_from_base, year_over_year), base year or expense stop, and estimates paid. Returns balance due and a full trace. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.cam_reconciliation@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

year.description: Calendar or lease year being reconciled.

category.description: Expense line as named in the operating statement, e.g. "janitorial".

amount.description: Building-level actual expense for the year, USD.

controllable.description: Subject to the cap. Taxes, insurance, and utilities are typically uncontrollable.

recoverable.description: Excluded expenses (capital items, landlord-only costs) are dropped entirely.

variable.description: Varies with occupancy, so eligible for gross-up (janitorial, utilities, management fee).

expenses.description: Building operating expense lines for the year.

gross_up.description: Gross up variable expenses to the target occupancy when actual occupancy is lower. Omit if the lease has no gross-up.

actual_occupancy.description: Average occupancy for the year, e.g. 0.82.

target_occupancy.description: Gross-up occupancy stated in the lease (commonly 0.95 or 1.0).

structure.description: Expense structure from the lease. Default: net.

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its full share of recoverable expenses (NNN / net).

base_year_expenses.description: Total building recoverable expenses in the base year, already grossed up, USD.

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its share of the excess over base-year expenses.

stop_amount.description: Building-level expense stop, USD per year.

oneOf.description: Tenant pays its share of the excess over a fixed expense stop.

cap.description: Cap on the tenant's share of controllable expenses. Omit if the lease has no cap.

method.description: compounding_from_base: reference × (1+rate)^years (often called cumulative, compounding). simple_from_base: reference × (1 + rate × years) (cumulative, non-compounding). year_over_year: prior year's capped amount × (1+rate) (non-cumulative). Map the lease language to one of these explicitly.

rate.description: Annual cap as a decimal, e.g. 0.05.

reference_amount.description: Tenant's share of controllable expenses in the reference year: the base year for *_from_base, or the prior year's capped amount for year_over_year, USD.

years_elapsed.description: Years since the base year (required for `*_from_base`).

estimates_paid.description: Estimated CAM payments the tenant made during the year.

tools.name: calc_debt_sizing
tools.description: Size the maximum loan under any combination of max LTV, min DSCR, and min debt yield for a given NOI, rate, and amortization. Reports the binding constraint, debt service, and resulting metrics. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.debt_sizing@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

value.description: Appraised or underwritten value, USD. Required when max_ltv is set.

min_dscr.description: Minimum debt service coverage ratio, e.g. 1.25.

round_down_to.description: Round the final loan amount down to this increment (lenders often use 1,000 or 10,000).

tools.name: calc_lease_remeasurement_asc842
tools.description: Remeasure a lessee's lease liability and right-of-use asset under ASC 842 after a modification, lease-term reassessment, contingency resolution, or residual value guarantee change: new liability (PV of remaining payments), liability and ROU adjustments with any gain (ASC 842-20-35-4), and the per-period amortization table (operating: straight-line single lease cost; finance: interest plus amortization). Warns where judgment is needed. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.lease_remeasurement_asc842@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

classification.description: Lessee classification (ASC 842-10-25-2): operating (single straight-line lease cost) or finance (interest on the liability plus straight-line ROU amortization).

period.description: Period index counted from the remeasurement date (1 = first remaining period).

amount.description: Lease payment due in that period after the event, USD: fixed and in-substance fixed payments, less incentives receivable (ASC 842-10-30-5).

payments.description: Remaining lease payments after the event, in ascending period order. Periods not listed carry no payment (rent-free).

remaining_periods.description: Remaining lease term in periods after the event. Defaults to the last period index in payments; set it higher when the final periods are rent-free.

payment_timing.description: Whether each payment falls at the beginning (in advance) or end (in arrears) of its period.

discount_rate_annual.description: Annual discount rate applied to the remaining payments, e.g. 0.06. Nominal: the periodic rate is this ÷ periods_per_year.

periods_per_year.description: Payment periods per year (12 for monthly, 4 for quarterly).

discount_rate_updated.description: True when discount_rate_annual was determined at the remeasurement date (ASC 842-10-35-5: required for modifications and lease-term or purchase-option reassessments); false when it is the rate from commencement (kept for contingency resolutions and residual value guarantee changes).

liability_before.description: Carrying amount of the lease liability immediately before the remeasurement, USD.

rou_asset_before.description: Carrying amount of the right-of-use asset immediately before the remeasurement, USD (after any impairment).

event.description: What triggered the remeasurement: modification_extend_term / modification_shorten_term / modification_change_in_payments (a modification not accounted for as a separate contract, ASC 842-10-25-8 and 25-11), reassessment_of_term_or_option (ASC 842-10-35-1 and 35-4(c)), contingency_resolved (variable payments became fixed, ASC 842-10-35-4(b)), residual_value_guarantee_change (ASC 842-10-35-4(c)(3)), or index_or_rate_change (ASC 842-10-35-4: not a remeasurement trigger by itself; computed as if remeasured for another reason).

tools.name: calc_prepayment_and_defeasance
tools.description: Prepayment premium, total payoff, and cost as a share of balance for a fixed-rate amortizing or interest-only loan under yield maintenance (PV of remaining payments or rate differential, with a minimum and an explicit discounting convention), a step-down schedule, a flat percentage, or defeasance (cost of the securities portfolio that funds the remaining payments plus stated costs). Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.prepayment_and_defeasance@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

balance.description: Outstanding principal balance at the payoff date, USD.

remaining_term_months.description: Months from the payoff date to the loan's maturity date (the balloon is due with the final payment).

amortization_months.description: Remaining amortization basis in months at the payoff date (e.g. 300 for a 30-year schedule with 5 years elapsed); 0 for interest-only. Must be at least remaining_term_months.

accrued_interest.description: Accrued but unpaid interest to the payoff date, USD; added to the total payoff.

treasury_rate_annual.description: Yield on the reference Treasury (usually the one maturing closest to the loan's maturity), e.g. 0.041.

spread_annual.description: Spread added to the Treasury yield for discounting, e.g. 0.005 when the note says 'Treasury plus 50 basis points'. Default 0 (Treasury flat).

minimum_pct.description: Minimum premium as a fraction of the balance, e.g. 0.01 for a 1% floor (default). 0 for no floor.

basis.description: pv_of_payments (default): premium = PV of the remaining scheduled payments at the discount rate − balance. rate_differential: premium = PV of (note rate − discount rate) ÷ 12 × scheduled balance for each remaining month.

discount_convention.description: Compounding convention for the discount rate. monthly (default): monthly rate = annual ÷ 12. semiannual: annual is a bond-equivalent yield, monthly rate = (1 + annual ÷ 2)^(1/6) − 1. Lenders differ; read the note.

loan_month.description: Loan month (1 = first month after origination) in which the payoff occurs.

through_month.description: Last loan month in which this percentage applies.

pct.description: Premium as a fraction of the balance, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

schedule.description: Step-down schedule in ascending through_month order, e.g. 5-4-3-2-1. After the last through_month the loan is open (0%).

pct.description: Premium as a fraction of the balance, e.g. 0.02.

anyOf.description: One flat annual yield for all replacement securities.

months.description: Months from the payoff date up to and including which this yield applies; points in ascending order.

rate.description: Annual yield on replacement securities maturing at or before that month, e.g. 0.042.

anyOf.description: Yield curve as a step function: each payment uses the first point whose months ≥ its month; beyond the last point, the last rate.

replacement_yield.description: Yield on the government securities bought to fund the remaining payments: a flat annual rate, or a list of {months, rate} points.

costs.description: Stated transaction costs, USD: defeasance consultant, legal, accountant, rating agency, servicer and custodian fees.

discount_convention.description: Compounding convention for the discount rate. monthly (default): monthly rate = annual ÷ 12. semiannual: annual is a bond-equivalent yield, monthly rate = (1 + annual ÷ 2)^(1/6) − 1. Lenders differ; read the note.

oneOf.description: Defeasance: buy securities that replicate the remaining payments.

tools.name: calc_walt
tools.description: Weighted average remaining lease term in years, weighted by area or annual rent, as of a date. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.walt@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

as_of.description: Date to measure remaining term from, YYYY-MM-DD.

weight_by.description: Weight each lease by area_sf or annual_rent.

id.description: Your identifier for the lease (ideally a FactLot lease ID).

area_sf.description: Leased square feet (required when weight_by is area).

annual_rent.description: Current annual rent, USD (required when weight_by is rent).

leases.description: Leases in the portfolio or building.

tools.name: calc_npv
tools.description: NPV of periodic cash flows (t = 0, 1, 2, ...) at a per-period discount rate. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.npv@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Periodic cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, …; negative for outflows (e.g. purchase price at t = 0).

tools.name: calc_irr
tools.description: Periodic and annualized IRR of periodic cash flows, solved deterministically; reports every root when cash flows have multiple IRRs. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.irr@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Periodic cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, …; negative for outflows (e.g. purchase price at t = 0).

periods_per_year.description: Periods per year, to annualize (12 for monthly flows).

tools.name: rules_tx_property_tax_protest_deadline
tools.description: Deadline to file a Texas property tax protest with the appraisal review board: the later of May 15 or 30 days after the notice of appraised value was delivered, rolled past weekends and Texas legal holidays, plus a conservative file-by date. Returns the statute citations and the rule's verification status. Verification status: verified. Cite rule rules.tx.property_tax_protest_deadline@1 and its statutes.

notice_delivered_date.description: Date the appraisal district's notice of appraised value was delivered (Tax Code §25.19), YYYY-MM-DD. A mailed notice is presumed delivered on the day it was deposited in the mail (§1.07(c)). Omit if unknown (May 15 is then the only basis).

tools.name: id_parcel
tools.description: Deterministic FactLot ID for a parcel from state FIPS, county FIPS, and the assessor's parcel number (APN). The same parcel always yields the same ID, offline. Use it as the join key across systems.

state_fips.description: 2-digit state FIPS code, e.g. "06" for California.

county_fips.description: 3-digit county FIPS code, e.g. "037" for Los Angeles County.

apn.description: Assessor's parcel number exactly as the county prints it; formatting is normalized.

tools.name: id_entity
tools.description: Deterministic FactLot ID for a legal entity (LLC, LP, corporation, trust) from its registry jurisdiction and file number, or from its LEI.

jurisdiction.description: Registry jurisdiction, e.g. "us-de" for Delaware, or "lei" for a Legal Entity Identifier.

registry_number.description: File number issued by that registry, or the 20-character LEI.

tools.name: id_space
tools.description: FactLot ID for a suite or unit within a building, given the building's FactLot URN. Suite designators are normalized.

suite.description: Suite or unit as written ("Suite 400", "STE 400", "#400", "3rd Floor" all normalize).

tools.name: id_document
tools.description: Content-addressed FactLot ID (SHA-256) for a document such as a lease, amendment, or estoppel.

content_base64.description: Base64 of the exact file bytes (preferred: every party gets the same ID).

text.description: Document text, UTF-8 encoded before hashing. Use only when bytes are unavailable.

tools.name: id_parse
tools.description: Validate a FactLot URN and return its kind, components, and short ID.

urn.description: A FactLot URN to validate, e.g. fl:parcel:us-06037:5432001012.

tools.name: fact_validate
tools.description: Check that a fact conforms to the FactLot model (subject ID, dotted predicate, as_of date, provenance with citations, optional AI-use rights). Returns { valid, issues }. Call before storing or sharing extracted facts.

fact.description: A FactLot fact: subject, predicate, value, as_of, provenance (with sources), optional rights.

tools.name: registry_get
tools.description: Everything the FactLot Registry knows about a parcel or legal entity: status, current cited facts (owner of record, situs address, property category, areas, values), ownership links, and external IDs. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

urn.description: FactLot URN of a parcel or entity, e.g. fl:parcel:us-48201:0420150000012.

include_history.description: Also return superseded facts from earlier snapshots.

tools.name: registry_resolve_parcel
tools.description: Find a parcel's FactLot URN from state FIPS, county FIPS, and APN, if the registry holds it. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

county_fips.description: 3-digit county FIPS, e.g. "201" for Harris County.

apn.description: Parcel or account number as the county prints it.

tools.name: registry_resolve_external
tools.description: Find the FactLot URN for an ID from another system, e.g. system "tx-harris-cad-account" or "us-tx-taxpayer". Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

tools.name: registry_search_address
tools.description: Find commercial parcels by situs address (normalized: 'Street' = 'St', 'Suite' = 'Ste'). Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

query.description: Street address or part of one.

tools.name: registry_search_entities
tools.description: Find registered business entities (LLCs, LPs, corporations) by name. Natural persons are not searchable. Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).

query.description: Entity name or part of one.

tools.name: registry_owned_by
tools.description: Commercial parcels currently linked to a legal entity as owner of record (inferred links carry a confidence). Requires a FactLot Registry (public-record facts about commercial property, each cited to the source file and record).
